rationale: C16 supplies a concrete drafting template: transmit an aviation commission report, identify the need for prompt analysis aimed at implementation, assign that analysis to an aviation-related coordinating body, and request advice or recommendations on the action to be taken. The child closely adapts this sequence to the Curtis Report, the Bureau of the Budget, and the unresolved interagency-cooperation recommendation. C15 and C09 contain related Bureau-of-the-Budget review-and-recommendation machinery, but their language and operative sequence are less closely matched.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am enclosing a copy of a report by Mr. E. R. Quesada on the implementation of the Curtis Report
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I send you herewith the Report of the Airport Commission
shared_material.explanation: Both letters open the operative matter by transmitting a report concerning aviation policy or facilities.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the Bureau of the Budget [should] undertake an analysis of this recommendation
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am anxious that a prompt analysis of the report be made, in order that implementation may be undertaken
shared_material.explanation: Both direct an executive body to analyze aviation recommendations specifically to advance implementation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: to present to me, as soon as possible, recommendations for such action as may be found desirable and appropriate
shared_material.parent_excerpt: make an immediate and intensive study of this report and advise me at an early date as to the action that should be taken to put the recommendations of the Commission into effect
shared_material.explanation: The requests share a distinctive operative conclusion: prompt study followed by advice to the President on action needed to implement report recommendations.
